name: Concealed Position
text: The concealed hunting-rifle profile can be used only in the first Shoot action the Long-Sight ever performs in the battle, whichever profile that action ends up using.

name: Salvo
text: The shooter may pick up to two different valid targets that are not in a friendly operative's control range and shoots each in its own sequence, in the order its player chooses.

name: FARSTALKER
text: Two small gifts of stance. In the Ready step of each Strategy phase the player may change the order of up to three friendly Farstalker operatives that are not in an enemy control range. And on any turn to counteract, instead of counteracting the player may change the order of one such operative; that uses up the turn but not the operative's own counteraction.

name: Call the Kill
text: The Kill-Broker's own strategic gambit, free of command points while it is in the killzone: pick any enemy operative as the mark for the turning point. Friendly Farstalker weapons have Balanced when they shoot, fight or retaliate against the mark. Each time the mark falls, the player may pick a new mark for the rest of the turning point.

name: Victory Shriek
text: Each time the mark falls, one Farstalker kinsman within 6 inches of the Kill-Broker earns Balanced on all its weapons until the battle ends. A kinsman can earn this only once.

name: ENERGISE
text: Charge the bow: every accelerator-bow profile has Lethal 5+ until the Bow-Hunter finishes a Shoot action with the bow, or until the turning point ends if that comes first.

name: Hardy
text: Critical hits glance off the Cold-Blood: an attack die that would deal Critical Dmg to it deals the weapon's Normal Dmg instead, when that is less. Devastating and other damage that is not an attack die are untouched.

name: Cold-blooded
text: The Cold-Blood finishes what others start. Against an enemy that has lost wounds, its weapons gain Lethal 5+ when it shoots, fights or retaliates; against one below half its wounds they gain Rending too.

name: Vicious Duellist
text: When the Cut-Skin fights or retaliates, each attack die its opponent discards as a fail costs that enemy 1 damage, dealt before any die is resolved.

name: Savage Assault
text: The first time the Cut-Skin fights in each of its activations, if neither fighter is incapacitated, it may at once make a free Fight against that same enemy only. This beats the usual limit on repeating an action.

name: Beast
text: The Hound can take only the Charge, Dash, Fall Back, Fight, GATHER, Guard, Reposition, Pick Up Marker and Place Marker actions, and can use only the weapon on its own card.

name: Bad-tempered
text: When an enemy operative takes the Fight action and the Hound is one of the operatives it could fight, its player may make it fight the Hound. And when an enemy ends a Charge in the control range of another friendly Farstalker operative within 3 inches of the Hound, and the Hound is not itself in an enemy control range, the Hound may at once make a free Charge (switching to Engage if need be) that must end in that enemy's control range.

name: GATHER
text: The Hound makes a free Dash or Reposition. Partway through the move it may make a free Pick Up Marker or Place Marker, and it then uses whatever distance it has left.

name: LONG-SIGHT
text: The Long-Sight settles in. Until it is next activated, the concealed and stationary hunting-rifle profiles gain Lethal 5+, and no enemy counts as obscured against any of its hunting-rifle shots.

name: Quick Draw
text: Once per turning point, as an enemy goes to shoot the ready Pistolier (or to catch it in a Blast), the Pistolier can fire first: a free Shoot with the focused dual pistols at that shooter, switching to Engage if it must. The shooter has to be a valid target for it.

name: Stalker
text: A Conceal order does not stop the Stalker from charging.

name: STEALTH ATTACK
text: The Stalker makes a free Charge of no more than its Move (no extra 2 inches), then a free Fight. The first time it strikes in that Fight it may at once resolve another of its successes as a strike, before its opponent. It must have a Conceal order, no enemy in control range, and stand within 1 inch of Light or Heavy terrain.

name: MARKED FOR THE HUNT
text: Take back your Pech'ra marker, then place it where the Tracker can see, or on a Vantage terrain feature it can see. Friendly Farstalker shooters have Seek Light on ranged weapons against an enemy with the marker in its control range. The marker goes when the Tracker next starts an activation or leaves the killzone.

name: FROM THE EYE ABOVE
text: Pick another friendly Farstalker operative the Tracker can see within 6 inches: it has +1 APL until the end of its next activation.

name: Ready for Anything
text: Once per turning point for the whole team, during a friendly Warrior's activation, the player may use the Meat, Piercing Shot or Toxin Shot rule for that Warrior, whether or not the equipment was chosen. This does not count against the rule's own once-per-turning-point limit.
